supportedStatement: The accepted directional surface-current samples satisfy the existing meaningful inward radial geometry rule within the requested sampling field. This is governed candidate support, not proof of a simultaneous persistent physical convergence feature.
notEstablished: same represented instant or defined compatibility window
provider uncertainty/noise discrimination or cross-source agreement
spatial coherence outside the sampled geometry
biological effect/fish presence/habitat or catch probability

science.candidateRule: sufficientCoverage and >=3 finite available projections; >=3 inward projections >=0.05 m/s and >=1 opposing pair
science.pronouncedRule: complete inward coverage; >=3 projections >=0.15 m/s and mean meaningful inward >=0.15 m/s
science.quality: Finite/available projections and coverage only inside convergence; no independent confidence, noise, freshness, temporal-coherence or provenance compatibility gate.
science.output: pelora-current-convergence-v1; type/state/strength/evidence/thresholds/interpretation/limitations/upstreamContract; no detected Boolean or confidence.

geometry.center: Separate point observation; not an input to radial candidate geometry.
geometry.requestedVersusResolved: Projection axes derive from requested direction labels. Resolved coordinates are retained; the convergence function does not validate resolved-cell separation or prove field-scale divergence.
geometry.gridEvidence: backend/fields/datasetRegistry.js declares nativeResolutionDegrees 0.25 for noaacwBLENDEDNRTcurrentsDaily. Registry metadata is not independent source/noise qualification.
geometry.temporalResolution: Daily product name; exact averaging/support window unspecified in repository archive inventory. Do not infer simultaneous instantaneous vectors from that name.

coherence.time: Individual timestamps are assessed; future/untimed available samples reject upstream. Remaining >=3 samples can still produce a candidate. No cross-vector equality or compatibility test in convergence.
coherence.source: Default endpoint and dataset are caller-constructed and shared. Convergence itself does not compare per-sample source, release or quality flags. No arbitrary alternate provider was injected.
coherence.magnitude: Each meaningful inward value meets the floor; no pairwise magnitude-balance or variance gate. Pronounced classification uses stronger counts and mean.
coherence.axes: At least one opposing pair and >=3 inward samples. Both complete opposing pairs are not necessary.
coherence.shearAndEdge: Separate gradient/shear/edge classifiers; convergence does not consume them. Co-occurrence is possible and not mutual exclusion.
coherence.persistence: Current candidate uses a single assembled sample set. Historical convergence persistence is a later separate consumer, not a confirmation stage.

convergence.interpretation: Multiple current vectors, including at least one opposing pair, show meaningful inward radial movement toward the center of the spatial sample.
limitations: Vector projections describe mathematical movement relative to the center of the sampling field only.
Positive radial movement is inward and negative radial movement is outward.
Positive tangential movement is clockwise and negative tangential movement is counterclockwise.
No convergence, divergence, shear, current edge, rotation, eddy, persistence, habitat, or biological significance is inferred.
Convergence requires meaningful inward radial movement from at least three sampled sides and support from at least one opposing pair.
A single inward current vector or inward movement confined to one side of the sample field is not classified as convergence.
This analysis describes horizontal surface-current geometry within the sampled radius only.
No divergence classification is produced by this engine.
No vertical motion, water-mass accumulation, current edge, shear, rotation, eddy, persistence, prey concentration, habitat quality, or biological significance is inferred.

governance.signals: resolveOceanSignals runs after current physics/snapshot construction; it selects supported feature signals and refuses composite support as a substitute primary physical feature. Not an intermediate candidate-to-detection translator.
governance.association: buildGovernedOceanSignalFeatureAssociationV1 requires explicit identity evidence and forbids current-supported-transition -> currentConvergence inference from terminology. No automatic convergence identity/promotion.
governance.definitions: No repository definition found that uniquely resolves currentConvergenceDetected on this producer object. Same-named summary fields and historical local convergenceDetected are different contracts.
governance.vertical: Producer explicitly disclaims vertical motion; no reviewed current path derives vertical velocity/downwelling/upwelling from this candidate.

options.name: CANDIDATE_IS_THE_DETECTION
options.support: Existing radial rule deterministically identifies a candidate; consumer tests accept true together with candidate state.
options.missing: No definition equates that sampled signature to the intended detected-convergence claim; temporal/quality/representativeness scope is not settled.
options.falsePositive: Promotes temporally heterogeneous or stale sampled geometry to an unqualified detection label.
options.falseNegative: Retains existing coverage/threshold limits; can omit weaker or undersampled real structures.

options.name: SECOND_STAGE_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED
options.support: Existing signal/feature architecture distinguishes support from governed physical identity.
options.missing: No executable intervening convergence confirmation gate or specified confirmation evidence found; cannot invent persistence or another threshold.
options.falsePositive: A nominal gate could merely relabel the same correlated evidence.
options.falseNegative: Invented confirmation/persistence requirements could exclude transient or otherwise valid candidate geometry.

options.name: CONSUMERS_SHOULD_CONSUME_CANDIDATE_STATE
options.support: Mixing/transition outputs explicitly describe candidate context, not verified fronts/mixing; organization index is corroborating support.
options.missing: No versioned handoff policy establishes which temporally/qualitatively mixed candidates may contribute; changing contribution is still a scientific behavior amendment.
options.falsePositive: Candidate support may be mistaken for confirmed detection or independent corroboration, especially with shared upstream ancestry.
options.falseNegative: Could preserve cautious labeling while still missing structures outside the existing rule; rejecting all candidate support suppresses current geometric evidence.

options.name: REMOVE_OR_IGNORE_FOR_NOW
options.support: No produced nested Boolean; no automatic upgrade is justified while its meaning is unresolved.
options.missing: Current effective omission does not prove intentional permanent suppression.
options.falsePositive: Avoids new positive support, but uniform/no-context language can overstate a negative conclusion.
options.falseNegative: Demonstrated candidate geometry contributes zero convergence signals even when supported by current rule.

options.name: PRESERVE_RICH_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_PENDING_SCIENCE_DECISION
options.support: Existing object retains unavailable/not-supported/incomplete-support/candidate, strength, counts and limitations.
options.missing: Still requires a defined meaning and acceptance rule for a future detected flag or candidate contribution.
options.falsePositive: Low if scope is explicit; candidate wording alone does not prevent downstream overinterpretation.
options.falseNegative: No new support path is activated until reviewed.

consumers.need: Code requires true plus candidate state; downstream purpose is supporting hydrodynamic/candidate context rather than verified persistent feature detection. This tension does not itself authorize a new input contract.
consumers.signalCount: Count of Boolean support conditions (convergence/shear/edge), not Ocean Signal publication, independent measurements or a probability.
consumers.organization: Transparent additive corroboration; prior isolated diagnostic 1->2 is an extra support contribution, not confidence/habitat/fishing probability.
consumers.transition: hydrodynamic-transition-context is candidate-context with explicit limitations; no verified front/mixing/persistence or biology.
consumers.species: Producer and interpretation are species-neutral. Prior diagnostic left confidence, summary and environmentalOpportunityEvidence unchanged. No direct nested-Boolean score/gate/ranking reader found; no blanket transitive-score equivalence claim.

boolean.conclusion: A Boolean may be valid with an explicit scoped predicate and retained rich state. Alone it collapses unavailable, insufficient, not-supported and unconfirmed candidate evidence; false must not silently mean measured absence. No new enum introduced.

dataSufficiency.answer: Repository evidence is insufficient to validate an honest unqualified detected-convergence Boolean. It is sufficient to reproduce the bounded candidate statement.
dataSufficiency.uncertainty: Native grid metadata, provider version/uncertainty and exact temporal support do not establish error/noise discrimination at 0.06 m/s. No external oceanography was researched or new thresholds imposed.

snapshot.candidate: Retained candidate type/state/strength/evidence/limitations; current-group narrative describes horizontal geometry with explicit limits.
snapshot.unavailable: Unavailable/insufficient-evidence with explanatory limitations, not proof of absence.
snapshot.detected: No production default detected-Boolean case. Prior manually true diagnostic is not a real captain-facing result.
snapshot.captain: Internal Ocean Physics headline/detail are expressly not final captain narrative. No promise of rendered UI text or new UI design.

future.nextGate: Define the exact convergence claim and evidence-sufficiency/coherence policy from science review before choosing producer/consumer/state-model amendment.
future.minimumAmendment: Undetermined until claim selected; no alias or threshold assumed.
versionImpact: If producer meaning/shape changes: pelora-current-convergence-v1 successor required; retain old records as old meaning.

If consumers admit candidate support: review/version affected pelora-mixing-zone-analysis-v1, pelora-environmental-transition-analysis-v1, pelora-ocean-organization-v1 and derived front/explainability contracts as effects require.
Adding nested Boolean may also affect pelora-current-edge-v1; audit that consumer.
Snapshot/evaluator/identity compatibility must be reviewed if derived content changes; no automatic serializer, projection or publication amendment here.
future.history: Do not rewrite/backfill old candidate evidence as detected. Existing history type/state readers and retained snapshots must keep original version/meaning; any recomputation needs explicit versioned semantics.

finalFocused.note: Final focused rerun includes adjacent represented-time probe added after initial full-suite invocation.
